fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects suspicious use of command-line tools such as curl or wget to download remote
content - particularly scripts - into temporary directories (e.g., /dev/shm, /tmp), followed by
immediate execution, indicating potential malicious activity. This pattern is commonly used
by malicious scripts, stagers, or downloaders in fileless or multi-stage Linux attacks.
fields.name: Suspicious Download and Execute Pattern via Curl/Wget
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "/curl" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/wget") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/tmp/" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/dev/shm/") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "sh -c"))
